author: the-dark-side
body:
Have you tried blight arrows in off-hand instead of dual-wielding? Volley 2 is amazing and I can't live without it. Any time I try using 2 weapons my dps goes down.

Also, I recently started using the ability Lunge since it is only 25mana and crits 50% of the time. Each time you crit you gain back life and health.

Im still fairly new myself so that's all I got. Good luck.
